audit: Phase 7C / 7C.1 external developability dataset candidate and GDPa3 workbook audit
purpose: Audit GDPa3 source provenance, paired-sequence independence, and assay compatibility without model analysis.
selection_status: GDPa3 workbook audited; eligible for HIC-only protocol review; assay protocol equivalence remains unverified

candidates.publisher_or_repository: Ginkgo Datapoints; official dataset access page
candidates.publication: 2025 Ginkgo Datapoints Antibody Developability Competition outcomes: limited model performance and a call for data standardization
candidates.sequence_availability: Sequences sheet contains 80 rows with 80 unique IDs; 80/80 paired VH/VL rows pass the repository's existing canonical amino-acid validator. The sheet uses vh_protein_sequence and lc_protein_sequence; sequence values are not written to this manifest.
candidates.experimental_label_availability: Workbook contains 13 raw assay/readout fields. Average-sheet nonmissing antibody counts: HIC 79/80; PR-CHO 80/80; AC-SINS pH 7.4 80/80; Tm2 74/80; titer 80/80. Original endpoint names and replicate summaries are audited separately; no values are inferred.
candidates.family_diversity: Exact all-pairs global-alignment paired-min identity proxy: 45 connected components at 0.70 (largest 16), 78 at 0.80 (largest 2), 80 at 0.90 (all singleton). These are sequence-identity clusters, not germline families. No explicit IGHV/IGKV/IGLV calls in workbook.
candidates.independence_from_jain: No exact VH, VL, or paired-sequence hash overlap among 80 valid GDPa3 pairs and the 137 Jain normalized records.
candidates.independence_from_aintibody: No exact VH, VL, or paired-sequence hash overlap with the 715 normalized AIntibody rows or frozen 476-row split population; TRAIN/VALIDATION/TEST overlap used sequence hashes only. No TEST labels accessed.
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Official Ginkgo release source and competition page identified. The local file was provided by the user as the untouched official workbook; file-specific redistribution license and original retrieval date are not independently verified. Keep raw file local and ignored pending terms review.
candidates.acquisition_note: No download was performed in this audit. User identified this untouched local workbook as the official GDPa3 file. Its structure and checksum were verified locally; origin is not cryptographically authenticated.

candidates.publisher_or_repository: Ginkgo Datapoints official Hugging Face dataset
candidates.publication: A high-throughput platform for biophysical antibody developability assessment to enable AI/ML model training
candidates.sequence_availability: Paired variable-region sequence fields described by the source; not downloaded.
candidates.experimental_label_availability: Ten developability assay types reported by the source; not downloaded.
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Dataset page reports CC BY 4.0 with restrictions and requires agreement to share contact information for file access.
candidates.selection_note: Not selected as independent cohort due to known Jain-referenced antibody overlap risk and gated access condition.

candidates.publisher_or_repository: Ginkgo Datapoints official dataset access page
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Official release listing; file-specific terms not verified.
candidates.selection_note: Rejected as independent cohort because source describes it as derived from GDPa1.

candidates.publisher_or_repository: Ginkgo Datapoints official dataset access page
candidates.sequence_availability: VHH sequences reported; paired VH/VL not applicable to the single-domain format.
candidates.experimental_label_availability: Ten developability assay types reported by the source; workbook not downloaded.
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Official release listing; file-specific terms not verified.
candidates.selection_note: Not selected for paired VH/VL validation; possible separate VHH-specific dataset.

candidates.publication_identifier: PMID:38530613; DOI not verified in this audit
candidates.sequence_availability: Sequence workbooks listed by source; no file-level audit.
candidates.experimental_label_availability: Integrated experimental developability workbooks listed by source; mixed-source records.
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Academic/non-commercial reuse note; underlying source licenses apply.
candidates.selection_note: Not selected as one independent cohort; source-level provenance and overlap require per-record review.

candidates.sequence_availability: Varies by contributing study; not audited as a unified paired-sequence file.
candidates.experimental_label_availability: Multiple developability labels across heterogeneous studies.
candidates.license_or_accessibility: Article/supplement publicly described; component dataset terms vary and require individual review.
candidates.selection_note: Not selected as a single independent cohort because it aggregates heterogeneous source datasets.

target.aggregation: Workbook-supplied *_avg field used as-is; a more detailed averaging formula is not documented.
target.qc_rule: No explicit workbook-defined disqualifying QC state was found in the audited data-sheet fields; no QC is inferred from measurements or replicate summaries.

population.exclusion_reason: The single record with missing hic_rt_avg is excluded under the preregistered complete-case availability rule; no label magnitude or model output is used.

analysis_plan.bootstrap_rng: NumPy default_rng (PCG64); fixed-size resampling with replacement; degenerate draws omitted without redraw and counted.
analysis_plan.similarity_analysis: Descriptive counts only; frozen paired-min bins <0.70, 0.70-<0.80, 0.80-<0.90, >=0.90; no subgroup correlations or bin merging.
analysis_plan.frozen_similarity_reference: 381 unique AIntibody TRAIN+VALIDATION sequence pairs; sequence fields and split membership only.
